name: Ransomware Containment & Recovery
description: Isolates affected hosts, disables lateral movement paths, and notifies leadership within SLA for suspected ransomware activity.

steps.description: Isolate the affected host from the network to prevent lateral spread.
Page the on-call SOC manager and IT leadership via SMS and email.
Validate and restore from the most recent clean backup snapshot.
Rotate credentials for all accounts active on the affected host in the last 72 hours.
Submit findings to legal/compliance for breach notification assessment.

name: Phishing Response
description: Standard workflow for confirmed phishing emails: contain, notify, and remediate affected mailboxes.

steps.description: Alert the affected user's manager and IT security awareness team.
Purge the malicious email from all recipient mailboxes.
Block sender domain and indicators at the email gateway.
Force password reset if credentials may have been entered on a phishing page.

name: Malware Eradication
description: Contains malware detections from EDR/AV, isolates the host, and coordinates eradication and re-imaging if required.

steps.description: Isolate the infected endpoint or server from the network.
Notify the assigned Tier 2 analyst for deep-dive triage.
Run full EDR remediation scan and collect forensic artifacts.
Re-image the host if eradication cannot be confirmed within 4 hours.

name: Unauthorized Access Response
description: Responds to suspicious authentication activity, brute force attempts, or privilege escalation.

steps.description: Notify identity/access management team of suspicious authentication pattern.
Force MFA re-enrollment and password reset for the affected account.
Review access logs for lateral movement or privilege escalation.
Disable the account temporarily if compromise is confirmed.

name: Data Exfiltration Response
description: Addresses suspected unauthorized data transfer out of the network, prioritizing containment and impact assessment.

steps.description: Isolate the source host to halt any further outbound transfer.
Escalate immediately to the SOC manager and Data Protection Officer.
Identify data classification and volume of records potentially exposed.
Block destination IP/domain at the firewall and proxy layer.
Prepare regulatory breach notification assessment (GDPR/state law as applicable).

name: DDoS Mitigation
description: Coordinates traffic scrubbing and upstream provider engagement during volumetric or application-layer DDoS activity.

steps.description: Notify network operations and upstream ISP/CDN provider.
Enable DDoS scrubbing / rate-limiting rules on the edge firewall and CDN.
Monitor service availability and customer impact until traffic normalizes.

name: Insider Threat Investigation
description: Discreet, HR-coordinated workflow for suspected insider threat activity requiring careful evidentiary handling.

steps.description: Notify HR business partner and Legal before taking further action.
Preserve forensic evidence without alerting the subject of investigation.
Review data access and exfiltration history for the associated account.

name: Cloud Misconfiguration Remediation
description: Addresses insecure cloud resource configurations identified by posture management tooling.

steps.description: Notify the cloud platform team owning the affected resource.
Apply least-privilege policy correction and restrict public exposure.
Verify no unauthorized access occurred while misconfigured.
